short.zh: 承接《极简输入》，通过“现场副驾”和“舞台复刻”两门科目，分别处理 AI 辅助现场控制与数字舞台复刻 / 预演。
short.en: A workshop series extending Minimal Input through Live Show Copilot for AI-assisted show control and Stage Replica for rebuilding, remixing and previsualizing digital stages.

premise.zh: AI 先帮助整理控制与空间，人继续负责现场判断、创意改造与最终演出。
premise.en: AI helps organize control and spatial systems while the participant remains responsible for live judgment, creative transformation and performance.
